pr_title: Fix String.ends_with() for empty string arguments

issue_context.title: String.ends_with("") returns false
issue_context.body:
**Godot version:**
3.2.3.stable


**Issue description:**
`String.ends_with()` returns false when empty string is passed as an argument. It should return true (same as `String.begins_with()` does).

**Steps to reproduce:**
```
# Incorrect:
print("".ends_with("")) # False
print("aaa".ends_with("")) # False

# Correct:
print("".begins_with("")) # True
print("aaa".begins_with("")) # True
```
